slides.title: A max is a test. Not a workout.
slides.body: Testing doesn't build strength. It shows what the last six weeks built.

slides.title: Every max costs you a week.
slides.body: Heavy singles beat you up for days. Max every week and you never train. You just audition.

slides.title: Weekly retests are noise.
slides.body: Sleep, stress and coffee swing a max by 5%. Real strength moves slower than that.

slides.title: Retest every 8 to 12 weeks.
slides.body: Build for a block. Ease off for a few days. Then find out.

slides.title: Track your sets of 3 and 5.
slides.body: Same weight, faster bar, cleaner reps. That's progress, and it's free.

slides.title: Earn the test. Don't chase it.
slides.body: Show up fresh, on a plan, once a block. The number takes care of itself.
